Khamoshi gahri hai.
Himmat unchi hai.
Grit seemayein todti hai.
Kayi baar sabse strong action inaction hota.
Khamoshi taqat hai.
Khamoshi choice hai, khaali-pan nahi.
Himmat sahi kaam applause ke bina.
Chup rehna samajhdaari ki nishani hai.
Grit lambi hai.
Himmat pehli insani khoobi hai.
Main fail nahi—bas 10,000 tareeke mile jo nahi kaam kare.
Perseverance hai nineteen dafa fail hona aur twentieth pe succeed karna.
Grit woh hai jo jaane se aasaan hone par bhi ruk jaye.
Grit wahi lagan hai jab duniya kehti hai ruk jao, tab bhi aage badhte rehna.
Khamoshi ko surrender se na jodo.
Himmat matlab regular aana.
Dard ko taqat mein badalna—grit.
Jo tumhe darata hai, karo—dar khatam.
Himmat, dar ka muqabla karna hai.
Courage hamesha roar nahi karta; kabhi whisper karta.
Himmat rasta hai.
